items.title: Willie Foster Interview
items.q: Faith. Faith. Fred Marlowe. And the drummer, a fellow called Zully.

ctx.x: Yes, sir. As Mason and White Bailey. I can't think of it. And Thomas was playing saxophones. Harvey playing trombone from St. Louis.
Who was the piano player? Was Faith?
Faith. Faith. Fred Marlowe. And the drummer, a fellow called Zully. That's all I know. Cason, Cason went up and Zully came on afterwards. After he came back to New Orleans.
